serviceTitle: Acceptance of documents by technical and vocational and post-secondary education institutions
provider: Aktobe Higher Polytechnic College (state-owned enterprise on the right of economic management).
basis: Order of the Minister of Education and Science of the Republic of Kazakhstan No. 578 of October 18, 2018 "On approval of the Model Rules for admission to educational institutions implementing technical and vocational and post-secondary education programs" (as amended).
docs: Document confirming entitlement to a benefit (if any)
portalTitle: Submit documents via the eGov.kz portal
psText: Information available in state information systems is obtained by the service provider independently, in accordance with the established procedure.

details.title: Terms of service

ways.title: How to apply
items: through the e-government web portal eGov.kz
in person at the college, in cases provided for by law

results.title: Result of the service
items: reasoned refusal to provide the public service where grounds provided by law exist

refusal.title: Grounds for refusal
items: submission of false documents and (or) information
the applicant and (or) the submitted documents do not meet the established requirements
no consent to access the personal data needed to provide the public service

details.appeal: Decisions, actions (or inaction) of the service provider may be appealed in the manner established by the legislation of the Republic of Kazakhstan.
